handoff.summary: Cycles 1-3 finished phase1-core entirely: T-001..T-005 done, all with exit-0 evidence (currently 17 test files / 138 tests, typecheck+build green). src/domain now holds the complete abstract model: types.ts (View/Vote/Block reference types, anchor at slot 0), blockTree.ts (immutable tree), forkChoice.ts (LMD-GHOST, order-independent equivocation tie-break), finality.ts (SLOTS_PER_EPOCH=4, supermajority links, justification fixpoint, adjacent-epoch 1-finality), protocol.ts (round-robin proposer, buildProposal/buildAttestation), messages.ts (append-only MessageLog with publishedAt), localView.ts (Delivery rules, instantDelivery default, viewOf pure filter, observe → {view, finality, head}), simulation.ts (advanceSlot: propose from own view / attest from blocks≤s,votes≤s-1 / per-validator heads; stateAtSlot = pure recomputation = rewind). Partition divergence and post-heal convergence are proven at domain level in tests/domain/localView.test.ts. completed_todos_since_reset hit the reset threshold (5) — this handoff is written for a fresh session reading only the disk.
next_actions: Start phase2-ui with T-006 (UI shell: 3 modes chain/network/global + slot advance, Japanese UI text). Read src/ui (M1) once for salvageable patterns (theme/canvas handling), then REPLACE it: build the new shell on src/domain only via stateAtSlot/advanceSlot + observe(log, v, slot, count[, delivery]). Delete M1 code (src/core, src/protocol, src/ui, their tests in tests/*.test.ts at top level) as the new UI replaces it, and update README.md (it still describes M1/discrete-event design — it is agent-owned, rides the cycle commit).
T-007 (chain mode local/god toggle) and T-008 (network mode + global mode) follow; batch policy allows 2 per batch at cost 4 each.
UI must consume ONLY src/domain exports (keep tests/domain/purity.test.ts green; imports go one way UI→domain).

Interventions (T-009) later compile scenario intervention data into a Delivery rule + protocol overrides (equivocation/stop) — the engine already takes delivery as a parameter; do NOT redesign the engine for it.
Essence gate to remember: UI 見た目・情報設計の大きな方針転換 and ビューの型/プロトコル骨格の意味論変更 must go back to the human — building the first new UI per 成功条件 1-8 is in-scope discretion, but a later large redesign is not.

Recorded discretionary semantics (no human gate needed, already in notes/reflections): SLOTS_PER_EPOCH=4; checkpoint epoch from block slot; same-slot equivocation resolved lexicographically; anchor at slot 0 / first proposal slot 1; attestations of a slot are simultaneous (votes visible through s-1).
